name: 深度报道
description: 原创编辑杂志风格。暖骨白纸面 + 墨黑正文 + 单一砖红强调，超大衬线标题与细分隔线构成编辑层级。适合深度长文、行业观察、人物专访、年度回顾。
source: 本技能自建（编辑杂志风设计方向）
promptSnippet: Editorial magazine style. Warm bone-white paper (#FBF9F4) with near-black ink (#14110F) body text and a single brick-red accent (#B23A2E) used sparingly for emphasis and rules. Large serif headlines (Source Han Serif SC / Georgia) create an editorial hierarchy; thin 1px warm-grey dividers separate sections. Asymmetric column grid, generous margins, zero decoration. Reads like a well-set long-form magazine feature.
